newsitem.title: USA: IRT Property to acquire Alabama center.
newsitem.headline: IRT Property to acquire Alabama center.

text.p: IRT Property Co said on Tuesday that it has acquired Madison Centre, a 64,800 square foot neighborhood shopping center located in Huntsville, Alabama for a total purchase price of $5,765,000 in cash.
Madison Centre is anchored by a 37,900 square foot Publix Supermarket and is 100 percent leased, the company said.
The company said in a statement that it expects a stabilized annual return on its investment, upon rental commencement for all tenants, of approximately 10 percent.

The company reported further that to date in 1997 it has purchased a total of six shopping centers for an aggregate price of approximately $49.8 million and that it expects to exceed its 1997 acquisition target of $75 million.
The name of the seller was not immediately available.
